title: Rigorous classification of the gathered 58 ECA rule numbers
method: Solo-1 evolution on a wide open lattice (P=5000..10000, W=20001..30000, horizon 30..500 steps), plus exhaustive periodic-boundary density test (all 128 configs on W=7), plus gap-1/gap-2 two-particle collision census (T=60..200, multiple bases) against the closed-form elastic landing law.

elastic_scatterer_density_conserving.collision: gap-1 ELASTIC: trailing delayed by exactly 1, leading free, count conserved, closed form {a+vT-v, lead+vT} exact for T in {1,7,50,120,200,400} and multiple bases.

elastic_scatterer_not_density_conserving.collision: gap-1 ELASTIC with the SAME closed-form law as 29/71 (trailing delayed by 1, leading free), verified exact for T in {1,7,50,200,400}, but these rules are NOT number conserving on the periodic lattice.

already_used_crosscheck.confirmed_consistent: Yes: 12/44/68/100 are the verified movers; 4 dies; 36 static; 76/108/132/140/164/172/196/204/228/236 are the previously-verified 'broadcaster period2-or-fullwidth' family (here: spreading fan or dies).

new_in_this_gather.elastic_quartet_completes: 28 and 70 are NEW elastic scatterers not previously cataloged (join 29/71). 13 and 69 are NEW merge-gap1 movers (join 12 and 68).
new_in_this_gather.note: Rules 15 and 85 (transparent density-conserving movers) and 51 (static identity) from the prior elastic survey are NOT in this gathered list.

bottom_line: Of the 58 gathered rules: 10 are clean soliton movers (12,13,28,29,36,44,68,69,70,71,100); the elastic-scattering physics family (billiard-ball, trailing-delayed-by-1) is exactly {28,29} (v=+1) and {70,71} (v=-1), of which only 29/71 also conserve particle count (density-conserving). No gathered rule beyond these adds a NEW interaction primitive. Everything else is a spreading fan, a degenerate absorber, or dies.

integrable_ladder_29_71.law: A block of k consecutive 1s settles after exactly k-1 steps into a spacing-2 LADDER of k particles, head always on its free trajectory (rule 29: {a + t - (k-1) + 2j}; rule 71: {b - t + 2j}). Block length k is a CONSERVED charge. Box-ball/ultra-discrete integrable structure.
integrable_ladder_29_71.verified: exact for k in {2,3,4,5,8}, T to 60, several bases.

collapsing_28_70.law: Any block of k>=2 consecutive 1s collapses to its two END cells in ONE step; all k-2 interior 1s vanish, then the surviving pair drifts at velocity v. rule 28: {a, a+k}; rule 70: {b - t, b - t + k}.
collapsing_28_70.consequence: This is EXACTLY why 28/70 are NOT density-conserving despite elastic scattering at isolated gap-1 pairs; only 29/71 are truly integrable + conservative.

twist_charge_and_clock.twist_Q: sum(p) - n*v*T is conserved post-settling; distinguishes internal decompositions (split block lagged permanently by 1 per pair).
twist_charge_and_clock.period2: x(T+2) = x(T) + 2v exactly after settling; ladder gas walks on one parity sublattice.
twist_charge_and_clock.verified: T to 120 random sparse configs + fixed split/contiguous cases; locked in test_elastic_shift.py (period2, twist charge).

tasep_identification.theorem: Rules 29 (right) and 71 (left) are EXACTLY the parallel-update TASEP / hard-core exclusion dynamics on a padded 1D lattice: a particle hops +-1 iff the target cell is empty, otherwise it blocks in place.
tasep_identification.capstone: Rule 29 == ECA 184 (the canonical right-moving traffic rule; truth table 10111000). Rule 71 == ECA 226 (left-moving mirror, reflection of 184; 11100010). Verified by full truth-table identity, by direct rule-184 traffic simulation on 50 random ensembles, and by hundreds of random-config TASEP double checks.
tasep_identification.evidence: Random sparse configs, 300 (rule 29) and 250 (rule 71), horizons 1..25: rule output == TASEP simulation in every case.
tasep_identification.consequences: Explains the elastic landing law (gap-1 trailing delayed by exactly 1 = TASEP blocking), the spacing-2 ballistic ladder (jam pierce), the conserved twist Q, and gap>=2 pass-through. The 'bomber' / 'governor' / twist-charge language all reduces to standard traffic-CA (rule 184) phenomena.
tasep_identification.non_injectivity: HONEST CORRECTION: the collision is CONSERVATIVE, not elastic/reversible. The time-map is permanently NON-INJECTIVE: rule 29 sends both {a-1,a+1} and {a,a+1} to {a,a+2} (identical forever); rule 71 sends both {a,a+1} and {a,a+2} to {a-1,a+1}. Exhaustive over the 2-particle sector (1770 pairs): EVERY merge is one of exactly these templates (58 classes per rule, all 2-to-1; the other 1654 pairs are injective). EXACTLY ONE BIT is destroyed per touching junction (trailing offset {1,2} behind a shared leader), lost in one step and never recovered.

composition_laws.L1_free_streaming: All pairwise gaps >= 2 => pure rigid translation (every particle +v per step, frozen relatives), verified 2978/2978. This sector is a bijection = reversible.
composition_laws.L2_block_melting: A touching k-block thaws into the spacing-2 ladder in exactly k-1 steps (elastic_shift.block_ladder).
composition_laws.L3_composition: For T >= max cluster melt time, the trajectory is the UNION of per-cluster spacing-2 ladders; verified 800/800 random configs, horizons to 50. Clusters at gap>=2 may couple transiently during a melt but never fuse.
composition_laws.L4_ring_fundamental_diagram: Periodic ring (traffic_law.evolve_ring): mean current per site J(rho) = min(rho, 1-rho), the canonical triangular traffic fundamental diagram (free-flow J=rho below half filling, jam J=1-rho above, max at rho=1/2). Verified over 51 densities, N=300. Mirror symmetry J(+1)=J(-1).
composition_laws.L5_ring_steady_state: After relaxation the block count on an N-ring = min(k,N-k): the MINORITY species is fully isolated (cars alone = free flow at rho<=1/2; holes alone = jam phase at rho>=1/2). Verified N=60,120,180 x 7 densities x 8 draws, stable by T=400 and conserved forever. Hence J(rho) = min(rho,1-rho) = (# isolated minority)/N -- one curve, particle and hole faces. Max jam size is init-dependent (multiple jams persist; no single-shock phase separation in parallel TASEP).
composition_laws.L6_reversibility: Rule 71^T after rule 29^T (padded open lattice) = IDENTITY iff the forward run develops NO contact. Rule 71 is the exact time-reversal of 29 on the contact-free sector; contact is the ONLY obstruction. Verified 997/997 free one-step + 700/700 free multi-step reverse exactly; 3/3 + 300/300 forced contacts do not (zero false pos/neg). Memory law: free flight is reversible (unit-like); erasure happens ONLY at a contact, at the exact multiplicity of the fiber law -- never in free flight.
composition_laws.L6b_fiber_fibonacci: The one-step fiber of a spacing-2 free ladder over n particles has size F(n+1) with F1=F2=1 (2,3,5,8,13,21 for n=2..7, verified exhaustively on tight windows; the ladder attains the max each time). It equals the number of ways to contact any set of PAIRWISE NON-ADJACENT junctions (independent sets of the n-1-junction path). The celebrated '1 bit per junction' is the 2-particle special case; honest general loss at a ladder = log2(F(n+1)) ~ 0.694 bits per extra junction (log2(phi)) -- NOT 1 bit/junction.
composition_laws.L6c_fiber_lucas_ring: Boundary selects the counting family: on a PERIODIC ring the wrap is one more junction so the junction graph is the cycle C_n and the fiber = Lucas L_n = F(n-1)+F(n+1) (3,4,7,11,18,29,47 for n=2..8 at N=2n, verified). open -> path -> Fibonacci F(n+1); ring -> cycle -> Lucas L_n. Both = #(contact-sets, no two adjacent junctions).
composition_laws.L7_erasure_ledger: FINITE-TIME SECOND LAW (unified, open AND ring). Folds happen only while a block melts, so over the whole sector the number of distinct T-step images is CONSTANT for T >= kmax - 1 where kmax = longest consecutive block in the sector. OPEN: canonical n=4 14-cell window (1001 configs): images 487/396/386/386/... plateau at T=3=kmax-1; step folds 514+91+10=615 configs folded; destroyed entropy log2(1001/386) ~ 1.375 bits, never grows after kmax-1. RING: all-packed config (n contiguous) exists so kmax=n and the ledger closes at T=n-1: N=6 [9..], N=8,n=3 [24,16,16..], N=12,n=5 [240,96,48,36,36..], N=16,n=6 [2024,816,448,352,336,336..]. All windows n=3..5 open and n=2..6 rings match. Erasure is punctual (contacts only), bounded (melt windows only), exact (log2(fiber) per fold); no slow leak in free flight.
composition_laws.L8_state_space_collapse: The ledger plateau IS the ring attractor, with a closed-form size. Under 29/71 on a periodic N-ring with n cars, the T-step image set stabilizes by T=n-1 and is then EXACTLY (as a set) the cyclic no-adjacency configs (every gap >= 2 cyclically = the minority-isolated steady states of L5 = the free-ladder attractor). Count = cyclic independence number indep(N,n) = (N/(N-n))*C(N-n,n) for n<=N/2, symmetric n<->N-n (holes). Verified set-identical on N=6..16: 6/2->9, 8/3->16, 10/3->50, 12/4->105, 12/5->36, 16/6->336, 16/7->64; count-match on 16/4->660, 10/4->25, 8/2->20, 14/4->294, 16/3->352, 12/3->112, 14/5->196. So L4 (fundamental diagram), L5, L6 (fiber), L7 (ledger) = ONE phenomenon: collapse onto the independent-set attractor; every trajectory there is a rigid rotation forever.
composition_laws.L8b_full_density_attractor: On the FULL ring state space (all densities) the attractor = cars-isolated OR holes-isolated = both complementary independent-set families, minus the 2 alternating patterns when N even: plateau(29/71) = 2*i_cyc(N) - 2*delta(N even), i_cyc(N) = total independent sets of the N-cycle (47 for C8 -> attractor 92 states). Measured exact for N=5..9 (22/34/58/92/152). The n-sector L8 numbers are the projection onto one parity family.
composition_laws.L9_erasure_audit: Tool: experiments/emanation/erasure_audit.py -- generic audit]measure of ANY finite deterministic map: audit(domain,f) -> image_1, images_by_t (erasure ledger), flat_at (forgetting clock), max_fiber, merge_classes, merged_configs, erased_bits=log2(total)-log2(image_1). Exhaustive over domain (measured fact). First dataset data/rule_erasure_spectrum.json (all 256 rules, N=8 ring): injective rules = exactly the 8 permutations {15,51,85,105,150,170,204,240}; 0/255 collapse to 1 state; mean one-step erasure 1.266 bits; 29/71 image_1=132 of 256 (relax to 92-attractor). Correction: traffic_law.evolve_ring now honors rule 71 as the exact LEFT mirror (was: ignored rule, right for both); count laws mirror-invariant and unchanged.
composition_laws.L10_recurrent_dimension: attractor(domain,f) iterates the whole-domain image to its SET fixpoint (the periodic core; f is a bijection there, so the attractor = reachable periodic points, |A| = the recurrent dimension = the size of the state space a rule can genuinely KEEP). Second-layer census data/rule_erasure_attractors.json over all 256 rules on the N=8 ring: immediate bijections = exactly the 8 permutations {15,51,85,105,150,170,204,240}; nilpotent-on-N8 (attractor={00000000}, honest for THIS N only) = {0,2,16,60,90,102,153,165,191,195,247,255}; 29/71 attractor=92 closing=4 (one-step 132, erased 0.956 bits, max_fiber 7); rule 0 closing=2 max_fiber=256.
composition_laws.L11_law_certificates: Tool experiments/emanation/law_checker.py + data/law_certificates.json: machine-readable certificates for candidate trajectory laws. A certificate = (label, stated domain, verdict) from comparing law vs true evolution at EVERY (config,T) point. 5 PASS: L1 free streaming (exhaustive gap>=2, rules 29/71); L2 melt window on every single cluster (exhaustive all T); L3 union law on merge-free sector (T <= g_min-2, provable since gap(t) >= gap(0)-t). 4 HONEST_NEGATIVE (first counter-example recorded): 29-traffic law on rules 44/100; free streaming on touching configs; and the MERGE SECTOR {4,7,9,10} T=6 (trailing gap 2 <= k for run k=2 -> 7 caught by {9,10} melt; law {10,13,14,16}, truth {10,12,14,16}). RETRACTION: traffic_law.law_trajectory 'exact for T >= max cluster melt time' was FALSE (found by the checker); corrected to merge-free sector; single-cluster exactness for all T stands.
composition_laws.L12_statement_certificates: certify_statement(label,meta,pred,domain): statement certificates (kind='statement') with exact first-failure datum. New fresh certificates in law_certificates.json: L13_ring_attractor_29_71 PASS over all (N,rule) in {3..9}x{29,71}: |attractor of ECA 29/71 on the N-ring| = 2*L_N - 2*(1 if N even), attractor computed over the full 2^N state space (L_N = independent sets of C_N; C8 -> 47 -> attractor 92). L13_bad_even_omitted HONEST_NEGATIVE: same law minus the even correction fails exactly on N in {4,6,8}.
composition_laws.L13_supervisor: Tool experiments/emanation/supervisor.py + data/supervision_verdict.json: the T1 law-supervisor -- believes a law only if every named PASS certificate is in the table (HONEST_NEGATIVE -> reject with counter-example; absent -> UNCERTIFIED reject; PASS of zero checked points -> no evidence). Demo verdict: 3 claims believed formally (L1 free streaming, L2 melt window, L13 ring attractor), 3 rejected (29-traffic law misapplied to rule 44; attractor even-correction omitted; uncertified law). The build can query verdict JSON instead of re-running simulations.
composition_laws.L14_repo_audit: The supervisor audits a REAL subsystem: experiments/emanation/repo_audit.py + scripts/certify_repo.py. First audited system = credit_commons.web.ledger.Ledger (SQLite mutual-credit ledger). Statement certificates measured on real code (30 seeded deterministic sequences on 3 accounts x 24 actions, trades incl necessity/harm + grants, 1e-6 drift bar): L14_gate6_conservation PASS -- conserved_total = sum(credit) + reserve invariant under every approved or rejected action; L14_bad_credit_sum_invariant HONEST_NEGATIVE (reserve absorbs fee residue / pays grants, so credit-sum alone is not conserved). FINDING (recorded, not introduced): credit_commons.sim.Commons.grant MINTS credit without debiting/tracking reserve -> gate-6 divergence from the ledger; L14 certified for the ledger only. CI gate: `python scripts/certify_repo.py --gate` exits 1 unless the persisted certificate table reproduces EXACTLY from current code (drift detection: missing/stale/drifted) and all 7 FORMAL claims are believed; the machine-readable law_certificates.json / supervision_verdict.json feed webapp and agents alike.
composition_laws.L15_law_proposer: Tool experiments/emanation/law_proposer.py + data/law_proposer_results.json: the T2 seed -- an autonomous proposing agent kept honest by the gate. Protocol: MEASURE |A(N,rule)| over N in 3..7 (full 2^N spaces); FIT each documented family (lucas_affine, lucas_parity, fib_affine control, constant) by bounded exhaustive integer search keeping only zero-error-on-train laws; CERTIFY each survivor on the FRESH out-of-sample domain N in 8..12 (recomputed attractor, use_cache=False -- a tamper test poisons the cache and re-checks). Result: exactly ONE law survives -- |A(N,29/71)| = 2*L_N - 2*(N even) -- PASS on all 10 fresh points (N=12 => 642 states); every look-alike dies at fit time. The PASS certificate joins the gate table (14 certificates); --gate rejects a proposer that stops generalizing.
composition_laws.L16_discovery_256: Tool experiments/emanation/law_discovery.py + data/law_discovery_table.json + data/discovery_verdict.json: the T2 proposer scaled to the WHOLE rule space -- a self-directed discovery agent. Protocol: MEASURE ring attractor of every rule on N in 3..6 (full 2^N state spaces); FIT from the documented zoo (constant, linear, quadratic, lucas, lucas_parity, fib, orbit2, orbit3); CERTIFY every train-perfect candidate strictly out-of-sample on N in 8..10. Report (deterministic, regenerated in ~3s): 48 rules certified -- rule 0 => |A|=1; rule 12 => L_N exactly; the six ring-permutations 15/51/85/170/204/240 => 1*2^N for all N; 29/71 => 2*L_N - 2*(N even) (re-deriving the proposer law) -- 208 no_small_form_law, 0 failed_to_generalize. FINDING surfaced by the agent: rules 105/150 are bijections on the N-ring IFF 3 does not divide N (N=9 => 128, not 512; verified to N=11): the census fact 'exactly 8 permutations at N=8' does NOT generalize to all rings, and the agent honestly refuses to float 2^N for 105/150 because its training window N in 3..6 includes the failing N=3,6. CI gate --gate now also requires discovery_fresh (the self-report must reproduce from current code) -- the system may not silently forget what it failed to know.
composition_laws.consequence: traffic_law.law_trajectory predicts every sparse trajectory with ARITHMETIC ONLY (no CA simulation). The proof-checking library can be replaced by deterministic physics laws on the characterized sector.

honest_negatives.current_not_conserved: '# of (1,0) bonds' is NOT an invariant: [292,527,990,991,1166,1754] has 5 bonds, jam (990,991) dissolves and the count rises to 6. J is a transient order parameter.
honest_negatives.count_is_only_exact_invariant: Exhaustive one-step graph of rings N=6,8,10: among {n,#10,#01,#11,sum-of-positions(mod N)}, ONLY particle count n is conserved across every edge.
honest_negatives.twist_Q_not_exact: Q = sum(p) - n*v*T jumps once at a contact (a 1-bit event); conserved only thereafter (asymptotic).

contact_pathologies.sticky_fusion: rules 12 (right) and 68 (left): TASEP when gaps>=2, but any touching k-block collapses to a SINGLE leading cell in one step (MERGE).
contact_pathologies.vaporizing: rules 28 (right) and 70 (left): TASEP when gaps>=2, but any touching k-block collapses to its two END cells (k-2 interiors destroyed).
